problem: Add audit-only routing to an existing fictional Python component without changing normal routing.
outcome: Describe an audit-only request without invoking its action; preserve existing reads and writes and reject malformed input.

acceptance.behavior: Read and write routes preserve their exact dispatch result and call the supplied effect stub exactly once when audit_only is absent or false.
Audit-only read and write requests return the exact route, original payload and audit_only true without calling the effect stub.
Unknown routes, extra fields, missing or blank payloads, non-object input and non-boolean audit flags raise ValueError with no effect calls.
Requests remain unchanged and returned records contain only the declared fields; whitespace in nonblank payloads is preserved.

non_goals: No web UI, provider, background service, network traffic, actual tenant access or deployment.
No claim of platform reuse inspection, controller reasoning, host independence or complete factory recovery from this behavioral fixture.
material_constraints: Use only the supplied dispatch stub for the fictional route action.
Candidate-owned tests cannot replace the protected evaluator or its required cases.

source_assumptions.statement: This fixture defines a fictional component contract; it does not describe private SPARK APIs.
source_assumptions.reason: Source-neutral evaluation for WP-115; real platform comparison remains NOT_ASSESSED.
